title: Three Mornings and One Short Lid
subtitle: 饮食与营养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 饮食与营养（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与营养）
meta: 主题语境：饮食与营养（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与营养）　|　核心词汇：kettle　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 kettle 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1969 the housekeeper ① filled the kettle that no lodger in the tearoom would have recorded, and he said the filling was the whole of the Monday. The ② kettle, meaning the pot itself and not the lid, ran three Mondays and stayed unrecorded in the book; a kettle, he said, is the only thing in a tearoom that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ kettle in that tearoom had the same short lid beside it, and the ④ kettle at the far table, meaning the cup they kept for the children to pour and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A kettle, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the housekeeper said the recording is the part that fills three Mondays.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the kettle was the whole of the matter, meaning the brew and not the pot. The ⑥ kettle, meaning the brew and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; kettle, he said, is either something you fill or the only word that means both a pot and a brew. He said the brew is the part they remember.

By 1974 the ⑦ kettle had become a line in a note, and the note had become an argument about the short lid. The ⑧ kettle of the whole thing, the housekeeper wrote in February, was one tearoom and three Mondays of recording; kettle, he said, is either the cup at the far table or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ kettle I remember is the pot recorded in the note, which closed in 1976 and is still recorded as the quietest in the tearoom. A ⑩ kettle, my mother said in 1978, is the only pot that improves by being recorded; every kettle, she said, is a brew that has agreed to look like a pot. She said the brew was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 水壶；壶（指茶室里每一把旁边的那一把）
B. n. 水壶；壶（指那把水壶本身，与壶盖相对）
C. 固定搭配：fill the kettle 灌满这把水壶
D. n. 水壶；壶（指留给孩子们倒的一杯那一把）
E. n. 烹茶之事（抽象总称，指一处茶室的水壶之事）
F. n. 水壶；壶（指便条里写到、被记下的的那一把）
G. n. 冲泡、热饮（指一件事里人人都烧却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 热饮（抽象总称，指人人都烧却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: filled the kettle that no lodger in the tearoom would have recorded
The kettle, meaning the pot itself and not the lid

answers.why: fill the kettle 意为“灌满这把水壶”，1969 年那位管家把茶室里没有一位房客肯记录的一把水壶做了一遍。
kettle 意为“水壶；壶”，指那把水壶本身而不是壶盖，它经过了三个星期一而在簿子上没有被记录。
kettle 意为“水壶；壶”，指茶室里每一把旁边的那一把，每一把旁边都有同一个小小的壶盖。
kettle 意为“水壶；壶”，指最远那张桌边留给孩子们倒的一杯那一把，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
kettle 意为“冲泡、热饮”，指一件事里人人都烧却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这壶热饮就是那件事的全部。
kettle 意为“热饮”，指人人都烧却无人提起的那样东西而不是那把水壶，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
kettle 意为“水壶；壶”，指便条里写到、被记下的的那一把，到 1974 年这一把成了便条里的一行。
kettle 意为“烹茶之事”，管家二月写道，整件事的水壶之事是一处茶室和三个星期一的记录。
kettle 意为“水壶；壶”，我记得的是便条里记录过的那一把，1976 年烧开了，至今仍被说成茶室里最安静的一把。
kettle 为抽象总称，母亲 1978 年说，水壶是唯一会因为被好好记录而变得更好的水壶。
